blockers.claim: The migration plan requires recorded plan/repository identities but never explicitly requires each probe attestation to bind to those identities or includes a discriminating stale-same-path test, so off-target evidence can still certify the run.
blockers.reality: Task 1 says to record the original plan hash and target revision and to scope target identity, while End states 2–3 require off-target results to remain visible and input identities to remain distinguishable. However, the named reusable gate currently validates only read_anchor.resolved_path and plan_title. It ignores plan content hash and repository revision. A stale or substituted plan retaining the same path/title therefore passes its on-target check. Merely recording the correct identities at run level does not prove that the probe opened them.
blockers.evidence: Primary source: skills/red-team/assets/red-team-gate.mjs isOnTarget() compares normalized read_anchor.plan_title and an absolute path under repo; the scaffold FINDINGS schema requires only resolved_path and plan_title. Reproduction against the frozen baseline piped one pass result whose read_anchor used the exact plan path/title but plan_sha256=64 f characters and target_revision=40 zeroes, while the envelope carried the correct fingerprint; the gate returned verdict CLEARED, expected=1, onTarget=1. Legitimate control: replacing the title with '# Another plan' returned INCOMPLETE with onTarget=0 and offTarget=['wrong-title']. Thus the failure is specifically missing content/revision binding, not malformed coverage accounting. Practical consequence: a reviewer that opened stale same-title content or the wrong repository snapshot can yield an unqualified clean result, undermining the frozen-input comparison and evidence provenance. Minimal resolution: make Task 1 explicitly require per-result plan-hash and snapshot-revision attestations validated against the run fingerprint, and add a regression where matching path/title with either stale hash or revision is rejected while the exact identity is accepted.
blockers.planRef: Context baseline limitation; Binding guardrails and End states 2–3 (lines 91–95); Task 1 identity/evidence obligations (lines 121–123); B1 frozen-input evidence requirements (line 167)
